notes.title: Kaardik Playtest v0.2
notes.notes:
We're releasing our v0.2 playtest version on Friday the 28th, so we hope you'll be able to download it and enjoy the game's evolution.

Playtest:

We want to collect feedback from our community and new players about the current state of the game, mostly related to battle mechanics. Please keep in mind this is just an early version of the development all the visuals and gameplay will be polished as we keep developing the game. The final game aims to have a full single-player campaign with a lot of exploration interactions and exciting battles.

Feedback:

We encourage everyone to play and send us feedback on our discord channel:

[url=https://discord.gg/NutVxG45C2]Kaardik Discord[/url]

notes.title: Kaardik Playtest v0.1
notes.notes:
Today we're launching the game's first open playtest! For now, it is focused on the main battle mechanics. To access the game you need to go to our Steam page and click on the "Request Access" option, after that the game will be available for download. We hope you like it and share it with others who don't know the game yet. 

[b]Playtest:[/b]

We want to collect feedback from our community and new players about the current state of the game, mostly related to battle mechanics. Please keep in mind this is just an early version of the development all the visuals and gameplay will be polished as we keep developing the game. The final game aims to have a full single-player campaign with a lot of exploration interactions and exciting battles.
